title: Isolation of exosomal RNA from cell culture supernatant using the Qiagen ExoRNeasy maxi kit
protocol: Harvest cell culture medium from 80% confluent cells grown in serum-free medium.
Spin media at 500-1,000 x g for 10 min (optional).
Centrifuge pre-cleared medium at 2000 x g for 10 min and filter using a 0.22 µm PES Steriflip membrane.
Freeze filtered medium at -80°C until needed.
Thaw 4 mL of cell culture supernatant on ice.
Transfer 4 mL of cell culture supernatant to a 15 mL tube and add 4 mL of XBP buffer.
Mix by inverting the tube 5 times.
Add the sample/XBP mix to the exoEasy maxi spin column.
Centrifuge for 1 – 3 min at 500 x g at room temperature and discard flow-through.
Add 10 mL of XWP to the spin column and centrifuge for 5 min at 5,000 x g at room temperature.
Transfer the spin column to a fresh collection tube.
Add 700 µL of Qiazol to the spin column and centrifuge for 5 min at 5,000 x g.
Spin PLG tubes for 30 s at 16,000 x g.
Add flow-through from step 11 to PLG tube and vortex for 5 s.
Incubate at room temperature for 5 min.
Add 90 µL of chloroform and shake vigorously for 15 s (do not vortex).
Incubate samples for 2 – 3 min at room temperature.
Centrifuge samples for 15 min at 12,000 x g at 4°C and transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new microcentrifuge tube.
Measure the aqueous phase and add 2 volumes of 100% ethanol.
Mix gently and thoroughly by pipetting up and down.
Add up to 700 µL of the mix from step 19, including any precipitate, onto the MinElute spin column.
Centrifuge for 15 s at 1,000 x g at room temperature and discard the flow-through.
Repeat steps until all the sample has been added.
Add 700 µL of Buffer RWT to the spin column and centrifuge for 15 s at ≥8,000 x g at room temperature to wash the column and discard the flow-through.
Add 500 µL of Buffer RPE onto the column and centrifuge for 15 s at ≥8,000 x g at room temperature and discard the flow-through.
Add 500 µL of Buffer RPE onto the column and centrifuge for 2 min at ≥8,000 x g at room temperature and discard the flow-through.
Transfer the spin column to a new 2 mL collection tube.
Open the lid of the column and centrifuge at full speed for 5 min to dry the membrane.
Discard the collection tube and flow-through.
Transfer the spin column to a new 1.5 mL collection tube, add 14 µL or 30 µL of RNase-free water directly to the center of the spin column.
Centrifuge for 1 min at 100 x g.
Centrifuge for 1 min at full speed to elute RNA.
